name: Dada v. Mukasey
summary: The Supreme Court held that noncitizens who have agreed to voluntary departure retain the right to withdraw that agreement in order to pursue motions to reopen their cases, emphasizing that statutory rights must be given practical effect.
significance: Respondents cite this case for the principle that noncitizens with final removal orders retain meaningful legal rights and that courts must interpret immigration statutes to avoid rendering those rights illusory.
